out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at front kitchen hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CFM placed stack of clean towels at front hand sink.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at hand sink located in back of kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CFM provided bottle of soap at hand sink.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pizza sauce on ice at 47F, shredded mozzarella on ice at 61F. Observed only bottom of containers submerged in ice bath.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS discussed proper set up of cold holding foods in ice baths. EHS and CFM discussed minimizing amount of food kept in container on ice baths, ensure more than half of container is submerged in ice bath, food is constantly mixed to ensure cold holding temperature throughout container, and taking temperature of food kept on ice. Shredded mozzarella discarded. Pizza sauce placed into 2 DR prep unit, as CFM stated he had added sauce to container <2 hours ago.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Observed two glue traps with dead pests under front hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. EHS discussed with CFM that traps should be inspected regularly and discarded if any dead pests are observed. LEDO PIZZA (Inspection Date: 05/18/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: shelving throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CFM will clean shelving in kitchen.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the front hand sink is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Call licensed plumber to fix drainage issues at front hand sink.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the back kitchen hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Repair leak at back kitchen hand sink

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed accumulation of food debris/splash throughout walls of kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy”. Observed no illness reporting agreements available in the facility during the time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS agreed to provide copy to PIC and follow up for them in 10 days

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Link for documents was emailed to PIC, will follow up in 10 days to verify compliance

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed handwashing sink across from the dish machine was using cloth towels to dry hands after handwashing
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC agreed to dispose of the cloth towels and to switch to paper towels, will follow up in 10 days to verify compliance

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. Rear handwashing sink did not have handwashing soap available during inspection
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC replaced handwashing soap

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Handwashing sink at the front of the ktichen did not have paper towels available
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC agreed to replace paper towels at front handwashing sink. Will follow up to verify compliance

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at front of the kitchen is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. Observed hot water temperature was 71 F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC agreed to have the handwashing sink repaired so hot water is available. Will follow up in 10 days

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Observed concentration was ) ppm during time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. PIC agreed to have dish machine repaired, will follow up to verify compliance

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): tomato sauce and shredded cheese kept out on counter next to pizza making station
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. Will follow up in 10 days to verify compliance
